name: @tty-pt/lemma
description: Universal Node.js and Browser bindings for liblemma Lexical Search & Unicode Accent Folding

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include native/lemma_napi.c -L../lib -Wl,-rpath,../lib -L/usr/lib -llemma -lcorm -o build/Release/lemma_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino
